name: coutreach-entities
description: Prospect marketing and Campaign Management, Phase 1 CRM change — prds/prospect-marketing/build-plan.md v0.3 section 1 (rulings 21, 26, 27, 28, 29, 30 and CM-2, CM-3, CM-6 of rulings.md). Three custom entities (typed Prospect, OutreachCampaign, OutreachTouch; stored with one leading C each), every field of sections 1.2-1.4, all seventeen links of section 1.5 (fourteen many-to-one, three many-to-many), the four stage fields on Contact and Account (section 1.6), and the Prospect option on Account.cCompanyType. ADDITIVE ONLY. Every name is given unprefixed; the applier computes the stored name. Handoff: coutreach-entities-crm-handoff.md. Two things this file cannot do and the handoff does by hand: convert COutreachCampaign.description (BasePlus ships it as text) to wysiwyg, and take COutreachTouch off the navigation tab list.

fields.name: businessName
fields.label: Business name
fields.tooltipText: The business half of the record, when the import row named one. The record's own Name is the business name when known, else the person's name; the application sets it.

fields.name: firstName
fields.label: First name
fields.tooltipText: The person half of the record, when the row named one.

fields.name: mailingAddress
fields.label: Mailing address
fields.tooltipText: The address a postcard goes to. Street, city, state, postal code, country.

fields.name: addressStatus
fields.label: Address status
fields.tooltipText: Dead is written by the mail vendor's undeliverable report (ruling 15); a new address from any import row resets it to Usable. A dead address leaves the record Qualified and selectable again the day a better address arrives.

fields.name: website
fields.label: Website
fields.tooltipText: A web domain promotes the business to a Company typed Prospect (ruling 21).

fields.name: email
fields.label: Email
fields.tooltipText: An email promotes the person to a Contact typed Prospect (ruling 21). Kept here as the raw row value even after promotion.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone
fields.tooltipText: A phone number makes the record selectable by a call campaign (ruling 20).

fields.name: funnelStage
fields.label: Funnel stage
fields.tooltipText: The rung on the funnel ladder. Advance-only, written by the application on evidence (a scan, a call outcome, a registration, an information request); never set by staff. Candidate and Client are read from the engagement and never stored.

fields.name: entryStage
fields.label: Entry stage
fields.tooltipText: The rung the record entered at. Written once at import, never again.

fields.name: stageChangedAt
fields.label: Stage changed at
fields.tooltipText: When the funnel stage last advanced. Feeds the Stale rule.

fields.name: entryDoor
fields.label: Entry door
fields.tooltipText: Which import created this record. Deliberately not called Source: Source is what a person says on a form (ruling 26).

fields.name: externalReference
fields.label: External reference
fields.tooltipText: The filing or registry number the import row carried.

fields.name: importBatch
fields.label: Import batch
fields.tooltipText: The file name and date of the import that created this record, for the batch view and for undo by batch.

fields.name: importRow
fields.label: Import row
fields.tooltipText: The raw row as JSON. The audit trail; never edited.

fields.name: qualifiedBy
fields.label: Qualified by
fields.tooltipText: The outside filter's name and version (ruling 11), or the reviewing staff member's name (ruling 18).

fields.name: sideExit
fields.label: Side exit
fields.tooltipText: Empty means the record is on the ladder. Undeliverable is not a side exit: ruling 15 makes it an address state (see Address status).

fields.name: sideExitNote
fields.label: Side exit note
fields.tooltipText: The reviewer's reason.

fields.name: campaignKind
fields.label: Kind
fields.tooltipText: How the campaign runs (CM-3). Postcard, Email, SMS and Call select an audience and run; Social media is its links alone.

fields.name: platform
fields.label: Platform
fields.tooltipText: Social media campaigns only: where the campaign runs.

fields.name: campaignStatus
fields.label: Status
fields.tooltipText: The application moves it. Cancelled instead of delete: a campaign is never deleted.

fields.name: selectionRule
fields.label: Selection rule
fields.tooltipText: The audience rule as the screen saved it, as JSON the application owns. Never hand-edited.

fields.name: selectionSummary
fields.label: Selection summary
fields.tooltipText: The same rule in words, for the record and for the sign-off.

fields.name: pieceCount
fields.label: Pieces signed off
fields.tooltipText: The piece count that was signed off (ruling 13). Live counts are computed from touches, never stored here.

fields.name: estimatedCost
fields.label: Estimated cost
fields.tooltipText: The estimated cost that was signed off (ruling 13). Always written together with its currency.

fields.name: signedOffByName
fields.label: Signed off by
fields.tooltipText: Who signed the run off. The action log holds the actor too.

fields.name: startDate
fields.label: Start date
fields.tooltipText: The campaign's window; selection runs inside it.

fields.name: vendorTemplateId
fields.label: Mail vendor template
fields.tooltipText: Postcard campaigns: the mail vendor's template for the card.

fields.name: postcardSize
fields.label: Postcard size
fields.tooltipText: Postcard campaigns: constrains the template.

fields.name: channel
fields.label: Channel
fields.tooltipText: Copied from the campaign so a touch reads alone. Social media has no touches: nobody is selected.

fields.name: touchStatus
fields.label: Status
fields.tooltipText: The attempt's lifecycle. Postcard: Planned, Sent, then Delivered or Returned. Call: Planned, Done. Email: Planned, Sent. A refused sign-off cancels every Planned row.

fields.name: outcome
fields.label: Outcome
fields.tooltipText: What came back. No answer, Interested and Declined are the three call outcomes of ruling 20.

fields.name: stageAtTouch
fields.label: Stage at touch
fields.tooltipText: The target's funnel stage when the row left Planned, so the campaign's reports stay honest after the record moves.

fields.name: scanToken
fields.label: Scan token
fields.tooltipText: The token in this card's QR code. Generated by the application with no ambiguous glyphs; never the record id.

fields.name: firstScannedAt
fields.label: First scanned at
fields.tooltipText: Ruling 16's evidence: the first scan of the code moved the business to Lead.

fields.name: vendorStatus
fields.label: Mail vendor status
fields.tooltipText: The mail vendor's last reported state for this piece.

fields.name: mailedAddress
fields.label: Address as mailed
fields.tooltipText: A snapshot of the address this piece went to, so a Returned touch names which address died even after the record's address changes.

fields.name: calledPhone
fields.label: Phone as dialled
fields.tooltipText: A snapshot of the number dialled.

fields.name: callNotes
fields.label: Call notes
fields.tooltipText: The caller's note (ruling 20).

fields.name: funnelStage
fields.label: Funnel stage
fields.tooltipText: The rung on the funnel ladder, continued here after promotion from a prospect record, or started here for a person who arrived through a form. Advance-only, written by the application on evidence; never set by staff. Candidate and Client are read from the engagement.

fields.name: entryStage
fields.label: Entry stage
fields.tooltipText: The rung this person entered the funnel at. Written once at creation, never again.

fields.name: funnelStage
fields.label: Funnel stage
fields.tooltipText: The rung on the funnel ladder, continued here after promotion from a prospect record. Advance-only, written by the application on evidence; never set by staff. Candidate and Client are read from the engagement.

fields.name: entryStage
fields.label: Entry stage
fields.tooltipText: The rung this company entered the funnel at. Written once at creation, never again.
